# Widget `order-items` — Put in order

**Pack:** core

**When to use:** Use when the material has a fixed sequence (process steps, stages, a chronology) the learner should be able to reproduce.

## Example block

```json
{
  "kind": "widget",
  "type": "order-items",
  "title": "Put in order",
  "props": {
    "prompt": "Put the phases of mitosis in order.",
    "items": [
      "Prophase",
      "Metaphase",
      "Anaphase",
      "Telophase"
    ],
    "explanation": "Chromosomes condense, line up, separate, then two nuclei form."
  }
}
```

## Props

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | yes |
| `items` | array of string (3–8) | yes |
| `explanation` | string | no |

The validator also checks the cross-field rules (ids that must exist, lengths that must match,
expressions that must parse). Run `npm run validate` after writing a widget.
